briefs.text: A magnitude 4.1 earthquake struck Myanmar in the early hours of today, the National Centre for Seismology said.
The 61st Venice Art Biennale closes today after six months, ending the world's biggest art exhibition.
The Nitto ATP Finals reach their final day in Turin today, closing the season's last showpiece.

footer: All events on this page happened on Sunday 22 November 2026. Sources: Hong Kong Registration and Electoral Office; China Daily Asia; Times of Israel; BBC; National Centre for Seismology. body: Polls opened at 9am today in Hong Kong's Election Committee Subsector Ordinary Elections, with 856 candidates contesting 723 seats across 31 subsectors. The 5,700 voters choose members of the 1,500-strong Election Committee, the body that nominates and elects the chief executive and picks 40 lawmakers.
Voting runs until 6pm at five ordinary polling stations, and the committee's five-year term begins on 1 February 2027. The results will shape the race for the city's top job next year.
lead.deck: 856 candidates contest 723 seats as about 5,700 voters choose the Election Committee that will pick the city's next leader
lead.headline: HONG KONG VOTES
lead.photo_credit: Hong Kong's skyline. Polling runs 9am–6pm across five stations. (File photo)

second.body: Gadi Eisenkot, the former army chief, begins intensive coalition talks with Likud today after President Isaac Herzog asked him — not Benjamin Netanyahu — to try to form Israel's next government. Herzog informed Eisenkot of the decision on Saturday evening; the formal handover of the mandate takes place today.
second.headline: EISENKOT BEGINS BID TO FORM GOVERNMENT

third.body: Climate talks in Antalya ran past their deadline with no deal, deadlocked over fossil fuels after a draft text stripped out every mention of them. Delegates worked through the night as a third draft was promised for this morning; nearly 200 countries are at the table.
third.headline: CLIMATE TALKS DEADLOCKED AS COP31 RUNS INTO OVERTIME
third.photo_credit: Wind turbines. The fossil-fuel fight has stalled the talks. (File photo)
